{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2025}}
'''R Mall''' is a [[boutique]] [[shopping mall]] developed by Runwal Realty (legally incorporated as Runwal Developers Ltd). The first R Mall was opened in [[Mulund]] in 2003. The second R Mall was opened in [[Thane]] in 2010.  Runwal Realty’s retail portfolio also includes [[R City Mall]] in [[Ghatkopar|Ghatkopar West]] and R Odeon in Ghatkopar East, in addition to the company's residential and commercial projects.<ref>{{cite news |first=Swet |last=Sarika |title=Warburg Pincus forms $1 bn shopping mall platform with Runwal Group |url=https://www.vccircle.com/warburg-pincus-forms-1-bn-shopping-mall-platform-with-runwal-group |date=20 May 2019 |access-date=15 June 2026 |work=VCCircle}}</ref> In 2016, the erstwhile Runwal Group transitioned into two independent entities–Runwal Realty and Runwal Enterprises. Runwal Realty is led by its managing director, Sandeep Runwal, who is also the chairman of [[National Real Estate Development Council|NAREDCO]] Maharashtra as of 2026.<ref>{{cite news |title=Sandeep Runwal appointed as new president of NAREDCO Maharashtra |url=https://realty.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry/sandeep-runwal-appointed-as-new-president-of-naredco-maharashtra/87914567 |access-date=10 July 2026 |work=ETRealty.com |agency=The Economic Times |language=en}}</ref>

==R Mall, Mulund==
R Mall, Mulund was opened in 2003.<ref>{{cite news |first=Nandini |last=Raghavendra |title=Shopping malls become family entertainment centres in Mumbai |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/shopping-malls-become-family-entertainment-centres-in-mumbai/articleshow/134134.cms |date=17 August 2003 |access-date=15 June 2026 |work=The Economic Times}}</ref> The {{convert|250000|sqft|m2|-3|abbr=on}} mall with a frontage of {{convert|700|ft|m|-1|abbr=on}} was designed by [[Chapman Taylor|Chapman Taylor & Partners]] (UK). R Mall is a 4-storeyed air-conditioned mall covering an area of approximately {{convert|80000|sqft|m2|-3|abbr=on}} on each floor. The site includes a 7 level car parking facility.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2003-04-05/mumbai/27280812_1_malls-dubaibased-landmark-group-lakh-sq-ft |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121103193844/http://articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2003-04-05/mumbai/27280812_1_malls-dubaibased-landmark-group-lakh-sq-ft |url-status=dead |archive-date=2012-11-03 |title=A slew of shopping malls mushrooms in the suburbs|date=2003-04-05 |work=The Times of India|access-date=2010-10-29}}</ref> It is the second oldest mall in Mumbai, and the oldest in [[Mumbai Suburban]] district.

==R Mall, Thane==
R Mall, Thane was opened in March 2010 and is located along the 60 m wide [[State Highway 42 (Maharashtra)|Ghodbunder Road]] in [[Manpada]], [[Thane]].<ref>{{cite news |title=R-Mall Shopping is now launched in Thane City |url=https://thane.city/2010/03/r-mall-launched-in-thane/ |access-date=3 August 2026 |work=Thane.City |date=4 March 2010}}</ref> It has a leasable area of {{convert|359000|sqft|m2|-3|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{cite news |title=Runwal Construction Private Limited |url=https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202510141037_Runwal_Construction_Private_Limited.pdf |access-date=3 August 2026 |work=CARE Ratings Ltd. |date=17 October 2025}}</ref> The property also includes dedicated vehicle parking facilities, and the [[Green Line (Mumbai Metro)|Manpada metro station]] is situated outside its premises.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Tiwari |first1=Neeraj |title=To keep fares low, MMRDA asks eight malls to pitch in |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/mumbai/mumbai-to-keep-fares-low-mmrda-asks-eight-malls-to-pitch-in-5767541/ |access-date=3 August 2026 |work=The Indian Express |date=6 June 2019 |language=en}}</ref>
